RuleOrValue: Legacy locate requires a cell center within numeric tolerance. Continuous motion uses a tile only as an index and checks the traversed tiles, including corner and border coverage.
Gap: A walkable tile does not imply that a worker knows the tile or its geometry. Surface resolution, cubic clearance and corner logic represent the world motor.

RuleOrValue: Enumerate up to four legal cardinal steps. Bounded breadth-first search returns nonempty food cues with graph distance and first direction. Continuous mode checks a clear segment from each sampled point to its indexed food.
Gap: Graph BFS can expose nonempty food around a corner without the body visiting those cells. It supplies exact identity and first edge with no sensor, no miss and no time-to-detection.

RuleOrValue: There is no receptor, image, light, vibrational or multimodal noisy perception path. Contact, distance and clearance are direct software predicates.
Gap: There is no visual or other receptor model here. Peer or brood contact elsewhere in Core does not feed this foraging decision. The paper outcomes do not imply global resource coordinates.

RuleOrValue: First activation requires an unloaded worker with capacity at its own exact depot. Initialize home path and heading or require prior trace continuity on reactivation.
Gap: The host or physiology selects the task. Exact depot, eligibility, initial heading and event start do not encode the measured effect of scout return, deprivation and local cues.

RuleOrValue: Priority is loaded home delivery, then away-from-home return when loaded, already returning or at path/move bound, then local food, then valid learned next edge, then weighted search.
Gap: A loaded worker away from home reverses the trace before considering other food cues. Exact reverse steps, hard trip cutoffs and blocked-leg Rest are unmeasured.

RuleOrValue: Minimize graph cell distance, sort equal-distance cues by physical cell and draw uniformly. When not in the source cell approach via its first edge.
Gap: The published colony comparisons do not isolate an individual with simultaneous cue access. No general distance-only ranking or uniform tie law was measured. Code ties remove identifier bias.

RuleOrValue: Exclude the predecessor when alternatives exist except a one-signal correction. Give visited cells base 1 and other cells explore_weight, add persistence for current heading, and add the optional normalized trail term before a deterministic weighted draw.
Gap: A constant straight bonus, loop-erased visited-cell penalty and predecessor mask are not a fitted angular kernel. F03 reuses F01 tracks and also has a separate new light assay.

RuleOrValue: Tile moves append or truncate at an already visited cell. Successful collection records the current path and timestamp as one learned route. Return traces the current path backward. Memory reuses only the next legal step at a recognized cell.
Gap: A single successful pickup writes a perfect stored trace for its available legal successors. There is no visit-dependent accuracy, graded memory cue conflict or general measured expiry.

RuleOrValue: Reject out of reach, depleted, full or loaded-clearance failure. Amount is minimum of request, source and remaining capacity. Move the source's current constituent proportions to external cargo.
Gap: Integer conservation and clearance are software guarantees. Actual crop filling, drinking duration and taste do not map to one fixed-time external cargo commit.

RuleOrValue: Deliver only at reachable nest contact and, for legacy surface, matching cell. Move all food cargo into colony nest stock. A remembered home tile in a mixed world may initiate traversal to the depot for an empty return.
Gap: A single depot receives the entire external load. Empty connector return is a route event, not evidence for resource transfer or recruitment.

RuleOrValue: Require clear swept segment and elapsed-time speed limit. Legacy planar resolution also requires adjacent located cells. Continuous foraging move clock uses maximum of configured step/connector time and a rounded travel-time lower bound.
Gap: The default global speed ceiling is lower than mean path speeds in selected unloaded worker assays. It is shared across motion contexts, with no load-specific measurement or turning law.

RuleOrValue: Search quantized passable neighbor edges toward a surface plane offset by loaded half-extent. Require an open neighboring surface tile with clear access. Cache one path per ant and walk it one waypoint at a time.
Gap: A height-biased search sees quantized geometry ahead within its budget. That is not measured knowledge of passages, a visual beacon or an experimentally established path integrator. Persistent blockage does not elicit replanning.

RuleOrValue: Reschedule after a completed or rejected owned action. Increment failure counters for rejection. Stop removes outstanding owned events and disables the forager while preserving its record.
Gap: Repeated rejection, timed idle and queue cancellation do not measure abandonment, rest, persistence or response latency.

Gap: Exact ColonyId masking would erase an otherwise present foreign cue. A single adjacent-tile field value does not express substrate dose, chemical identity, antenna sampling or polarity.

Gap: No chemical mass measurement, diffusion or advection exists in Core. The time constant, threshold-crossing duration and raw chemical half-life are distinct.

RuleOrValue: Only one visible signal on the predecessor can permit immediate reversal. Add trail_weight times capped normalized signal to the exploration and persistence weights. A chosen edge with signal above cutoff is labeled FollowTrail.
Gap: The sole-predecessor exception, clipped additive weight and deterministic memory precedence are not equivalent to those assays. FollowTrail is a visible-cue label on the chosen edge, including the zero-response configuration.

RuleOrValue: Workers can change their steps through the shared field. Departure uses the individual enrollment/autonomy policy. There is no separate recruit state, scout announcement, antennal recruitment exchange or direct food sharing of coordinates.
Gap: A surface field acts on workers already in the decision loop. There is no modeled effect of scout marks on a nestmate becoming a forager, no pre-feeder relay and no route-aware group feedback test matched to these papers.

RuleOrValue: Report visited tiles, undirected edge traversals, counted first discovery, active trail cells, current units and deposited-minus-current units. Discovery is a recorded cue and differs from a collection.
Gap: Visited edges, candidate-source discovery, a signal-bearing step and mass delivered answer different questions. Deposited minus live units includes cutoff losses and is not chemical evaporation measured in nature.
